question.text: How do changes in automotive radar technology affect the measurement capability required from Vector Network Analyzer?

exchange.sent: How do changes in automotive radar technology affect the measurement capability required from Vector Network Analyzer?

answer.answer:
### Short answer
The passages do not directly state a causal rule for “changes in automotive radar technology,” but they show that automotive radar test coverage includes 24 GHz to 24.25 GHz, 76 GHz to 81 GHz, and 24 GHz to 44 GHz RF bands, plus instantaneous bandwidths up to 4 GHz or 5 GHz depending on configuration [52].
### Supported facts
AREG800A automotive radar echo generation covers RF bands of 24 GHz to 24.25 GHz for R&S AREG8-24S / AREG8-24D, 76 GHz to 81 GHz for R&S AREG8-81S / AREG8-81D / AREG8-81WS / AREG8-81WD and R&S QAT100, and 24 GHz to 44 GHz for R&S FE44S [52].
The R&S AREG8-81S / R&S AREG8-81D frontend has an RF frequency range of 76.0 GHz to 81.0 GHz and RF instantaneous bandwidth entries of 1 GHz, 2 GHz with R&S AREG8-B9 and R&S AREG8-K527, and 4 GHz [51].
R&S QAT100 with AREG800A has RF frequency ranges of 76 GHz to 77 GHz and 77 GHz to 81 GHz, with 4 GHz RF instantaneous bandwidth [49].
AREG800A base-unit instantaneous IF bandwidth depends on option and is listed as 1 GHz, 2 GHz, or 5 GHz, with IF frequency ranges of 1.1 GHz to 2.1 GHz, 0.7 GHz to 2.7 GHz, and 0.7 GHz to 5.7 GHz [52].
AREG800A suppression-of-ghost-objects measurement uses a vector network analyzer in time domain, with 125 kHz frequency step size, 100 kHz measurement bandwidth, –10 dBm source power, 2 m wanted artificial-object distance, and spans of 1.1 GHz to 2.1 GHz, 0.7 GHz to 2.7 GHz, or 0.7 GHz to 5.7 GHz depending on bandwidth [8].
AREG800A IF transfer measurements using a vector network analyzer specify 2.5 MHz frequency step size, 1 kHz measurement bandwidth, –10 dBm source power, and spans of 1.1 GHz to 2.1 GHz, 0.7 GHz to 2.7 GHz, or 0.7 GHz to 5.7 GHz depending on bandwidth [9].
R&S AREG8-81S / R&S AREG8-81D RF transfer characteristics are measured from RX waveguide input to waveguide TX output connector with 2.5 MHz frequency step size, 1 kHz measurement bandwidth, Hann normal-gate window, and bandpass filter [48].
For those R&S AREG8-81S / R&S AREG8-81D RF transfer measurements, amplitude flatness is stated for 1 GHz, 2 GHz, and 4 GHz bandwidths, and group delay flatness is also stated for 1 GHz, 2 GHz, and 4 GHz bandwidths [48].
The R&S ZNB3000 VNA family base frequency range extends from 9 kHz to 43.5 GHz, and with frequency upgrade options reaches up to 54.0 GHz [14].
The R&S ZNB3000 model overview lists R&S ZNB3020 up to 20.0 GHz base / 26.5 GHz upgraded, R&S ZNB3032 up to 32.0 GHz base / 43.5 GHz upgraded, and R&S ZNB3044 up to 43.5 GHz base / 54.0 GHz upgraded [59].
The R&S ZNB3000 common hardware options include R&S ZNB3-B8 mmWave converter LO/IF for R&S ZNB3020 only with the R&S ZNB3-B26x option, and for R&S ZNB3032 and R&S ZNB3044 [61].
The R&S ZNA67EXT is a 1.0 mm vector network analyzer system covering 10 MHz to 110 GHz [20].
The R&S ZNA67EXT core specifications list 10 MHz to 110 GHz frequency range, 1 Hz frequency resolution, 1 to 100001 measurement points, and 1 Hz to 1.5 MHz measurement bandwidths [68].
### Inference
【推論】If automotive radar test bandwidth expands to 4 GHz RF instantaneous bandwidth or 5 GHz IF bandwidth, the VNA setup must support measurements over wider spans such as 0.7 GHz to 5.7 GHz and use the stated step size, bandwidth, source power, and time-domain conditions for the relevant AREG800A measurements.[49][52][8][9]

[[R&S ZNA67EXT]] 是 1.0 mm [[Vector Network Analyzer]] system，涵蓋 **10 MHz to 110 GHz**。系統由一台 [[R&S ZNA67]] vector network analyzer 與最多四個 external test sets 組成；來源說明規格只對照 R&S ZNA67 rear panel designation scheme 中 type、serial numbers 與正確 port 位置完全一致的 system configuration 有效。

主要產品資訊：

- Impedance：**50 Ω**。
- Test port connector：**1.0 mm, male**。
- Number of test ports：models **.12/.13/.15/.16** 為 **2**；models **.14/.17** 為 **4**。
- Frequency range：**10 MHz to 110 GHz**。
- Frequency resolution：**1 Hz**。
- Number of measurement points：user-selectable **1 to 100001**。
- Measurement bandwidths：**1 Hz to 1.5 MHz**，1/1.5/2/3/5/7 steps。
- Calibration interval：**1 year**。

來源列出 6 個 base unit order no.，包含 standard power 與 high power、2 test ports 與 4 test ports variants；也列出 [[R&S ZNA67]] base unit options、software licenses / firmware options、cable sets、calibration kit、power sensor 與 test cable。

本次 ingest 也補入來源中的資料定義、uncorrected system data、trace stability、temperature dependence，以及讀圖封面資訊。讀圖資訊來自來源的「【讀圖補充】」段落，可信度低於正文。

answer.text:
### Short answer
The passages do not directly state a causal rule for “changes in automotive radar technology,” but they show that automotive radar test coverage includes 24 GHz to 24.25 GHz, 76 GHz to 81 GHz, and 24 GHz to 44 GHz RF bands, plus instantaneous bandwidths up to 4 GHz or 5 GHz depending on configuration [52].
### Supported facts
AREG800A automotive radar echo generation covers RF bands of 24 GHz to 24.25 GHz for R&S AREG8-24S / AREG8-24D, 76 GHz to 81 GHz for R&S AREG8-81S / AREG8-81D / AREG8-81WS / AREG8-81WD and R&S QAT100, and 24 GHz to 44 GHz for R&S FE44S [52].
The R&S AREG8-81S / R&S AREG8-81D frontend has an RF frequency range of 76.0 GHz to 81.0 GHz and RF instantaneous bandwidth entries of 1 GHz, 2 GHz with R&S AREG8-B9 and R&S AREG8-K527, and 4 GHz [51].
R&S QAT100 with AREG800A has RF frequency ranges of 76 GHz to 77 GHz and 77 GHz to 81 GHz, with 4 GHz RF instantaneous bandwidth [49].
AREG800A base-unit instantaneous IF bandwidth depends on option and is listed as 1 GHz, 2 GHz, or 5 GHz, with IF frequency ranges of 1.1 GHz to 2.1 GHz, 0.7 GHz to 2.7 GHz, and 0.7 GHz to 5.7 GHz [52].
AREG800A suppression-of-ghost-objects measurement uses a vector network analyzer in time domain, with 125 kHz frequency step size, 100 kHz measurement bandwidth, –10 dBm source power, 2 m wanted artificial-object distance, and spans of 1.1 GHz to 2.1 GHz, 0.7 GHz to 2.7 GHz, or 0.7 GHz to 5.7 GHz depending on bandwidth [8].
AREG800A IF transfer measurements using a vector network analyzer specify 2.5 MHz frequency step size, 1 kHz measurement bandwidth, –10 dBm source power, and spans of 1.1 GHz to 2.1 GHz, 0.7 GHz to 2.7 GHz, or 0.7 GHz to 5.7 GHz depending on bandwidth [9].
R&S AREG8-81S / R&S AREG8-81D RF transfer characteristics are measured from RX waveguide input to waveguide TX output connector with 2.5 MHz frequency step size, 1 kHz measurement bandwidth, Hann normal-gate window, and bandpass filter [48].
For those R&S AREG8-81S / R&S AREG8-81D RF transfer measurements, amplitude flatness is stated for 1 GHz, 2 GHz, and 4 GHz bandwidths, and group delay flatness is also stated for 1 GHz, 2 GHz, and 4 GHz bandwidths [48].
The R&S ZNB3000 VNA family base frequency range extends from 9 kHz to 43.5 GHz, and with frequency upgrade options reaches up to 54.0 GHz [14].
The R&S ZNB3000 model overview lists R&S ZNB3020 up to 20.0 GHz base / 26.5 GHz upgraded, R&S ZNB3032 up to 32.0 GHz base / 43.5 GHz upgraded, and R&S ZNB3044 up to 43.5 GHz base / 54.0 GHz upgraded [59].
The R&S ZNB3000 common hardware options include R&S ZNB3-B8 mmWave converter LO/IF for R&S ZNB3020 only with the R&S ZNB3-B26x option, and for R&S ZNB3032 and R&S ZNB3044 [61].
The R&S ZNA67EXT is a 1.0 mm vector network analyzer system covering 10 MHz to 110 GHz [20].
The R&S ZNA67EXT core specifications list 10 MHz to 110 GHz frequency range, 1 Hz frequency resolution, 1 to 100001 measurement points, and 1 Hz to 1.5 MHz measurement bandwidths [68].
### Inference
【推論】If automotive radar test bandwidth expands to 4 GHz RF instantaneous bandwidth or 5 GHz IF bandwidth, the VNA setup must support measurements over wider spans such as 0.7 GHz to 5.7 GHz and use the stated step size, bandwidth, source power, and time-domain conditions for the relevant AREG800A measurements.[49][52][8][9]

### Short answer
The passages do not directly state a causal rule for “changes in automotive radar technology,” but they show that automotive radar test coverage includes 24 GHz to 24.25 GHz, 76 GHz to 81 GHz, and 24 GHz to 44 GHz RF bands, plus instantaneous bandwidths up to 4 GHz or 5 GHz depending on configuration [52].
### Supported facts
AREG800A automotive radar echo generation covers RF bands of 24 GHz to 24.25 GHz for R&S AREG8-24S / AREG8-24D, 76 GHz to 81 GHz for R&S AREG8-81S / AREG8-81D / AREG8-81WS / AREG8-81WD and R&S QAT100, and 24 GHz to 44 GHz for R&S FE44S [52].
The R&S AREG8-81S / R&S AREG8-81D frontend has an RF frequency range of 76.0 GHz to 81.0 GHz and RF instantaneous bandwidth entries of 1 GHz, 2 GHz with R&S AREG8-B9 and R&S AREG8-K527, and 4 GHz [51].
R&S QAT100 with AREG800A has RF frequency ranges of 76 GHz to 77 GHz and 77 GHz to 81 GHz, with 4 GHz RF instantaneous bandwidth [49].
AREG800A base-unit instantaneous IF bandwidth depends on option and is listed as 1 GHz, 2 GHz, or 5 GHz, with IF frequency ranges of 1.1 GHz to 2.1 GHz, 0.7 GHz to 2.7 GHz, and 0.7 GHz to 5.7 GHz [52].
AREG800A suppression-of-ghost-objects measurement uses a vector network analyzer in time domain, with 125 kHz frequency step size, 100 kHz measurement bandwidth, –10 dBm source power, 2 m wanted artificial-object distance, and spans of 1.1 GHz to 2.1 GHz, 0.7 GHz to 2.7 GHz, or 0.7 GHz to 5.7 GHz depending on bandwidth [8].
AREG800A IF transfer measurements using a vector network analyzer specify 2.5 MHz frequency step size, 1 kHz measurement bandwidth, –10 dBm source power, and spans of 1.1 GHz to 2.1 GHz, 0.7 GHz to 2.7 GHz, or 0.7 GHz to 5.7 GHz depending on bandwidth [9].
R&S AREG8-81S / R&S AREG8-81D RF transfer characteristics are measured from RX waveguide input to waveguide TX output connector with 2.5 MHz frequency step size, 1 kHz measurement bandwidth, Hann normal-gate window, and bandpass filter [48].
For those R&S AREG8-81S / R&S AREG8-81D RF transfer measurements, amplitude flatness is stated for 1 GHz, 2 GHz, and 4 GHz bandwidths, and group delay flatness is also stated for 1 GHz, 2 GHz, and 4 GHz bandwidths [48].
The R&S ZNB3000 VNA family base frequency range extends from 9 kHz to 43.5 GHz, and with frequency upgrade options reaches up to 54.0 GHz [14].
The R&S ZNB3000 model overview lists R&S ZNB3020 up to 20.0 GHz base / 26.5 GHz upgraded, R&S ZNB3032 up to 32.0 GHz base / 43.5 GHz upgraded, and R&S ZNB3044 up to 43.5 GHz base / 54.0 GHz upgraded [59].
The R&S ZNB3000 common hardware options include R&S ZNB3-B8 mmWave converter LO/IF for R&S ZNB3020 only with the R&S ZNB3-B26x option, and for R&S ZNB3032 and R&S ZNB3044 [61].
The R&S ZNA67EXT is a 1.0 mm vector network analyzer system covering 10 MHz to 110 GHz [20].
The R&S ZNA67EXT core specifications list 10 MHz to 110 GHz frequency range, 1 Hz frequency resolution, 1 to 100001 measurement points, and 1 Hz to 1.5 MHz measurement bandwidths [68].
### Inference
【推論】If automotive radar test bandwidth expands to 4 GHz RF instantaneous bandwidth or 5 GHz IF bandwidth, the VNA setup must support measurements over wider spans such as 0.7 GHz to 5.7 GHz and use the stated step size, bandwidth, source power, and time-domain conditions for the relevant AREG800A measurements.[49][52][8][9]
